paragraphs: ServiceNow, Inc. is an American software company that supplies cloud computing platforms for the creation and management of automated business workflows. The company was founded in Santa Clara, California, United States, in 2003 by Fred Luddy. It is listed on the New York Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the S&P 100 and S&P 500 indices.
description.title: ServiceNow

people.name: William R. McDermott
people.title: Chairman and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: McDermott is Chairman and Chief Executive Officer. In October 2019, the company entered into an employment agreement with him to serve as President and Chief Executive Officer.
people.quote:
William R. McDermott

people.name: Gina Mastantuono
people.title: President and Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Mastantuono became President and Chief Financial Officer in January 2025 after serving as Chief Financial Officer since January 2020. Previously, she was Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Ingram Micro.
people.quote:
Gina Mastantuono 
 President and Chief Financial Officer 
 In current role since: January 2025

people.name: Amit Zavery
people.title: President, Chief Product Officer and Chief Operating Officer
people.bio: Zavery has served in his current role since November 2024. Previously, he was Vice President and General Manager and Head of Platform of Google Cloud and held numerous leadership roles at Oracle.
people.quote:
Amit Zavery 
 President, Chief Product Officer and Chief Operating Officer

people.name: Paul Fipps
people.title: President, Global Customer Operations
people.bio: Fipps became President, Global Customer Operations in April 2025 after serving as Executive Vice President of Worldwide Sales. He joined ServiceNow in March 2021 and previously held leadership roles at Under Armour.
people.quote:
Paul Fipps 
 President, Global Customer Operations 
 In current role since: April 2025

people.name: Jacqueline Canney
people.title: Chief People and AI Enablement Officer
people.bio: Canney became Chief People and AI Enablement Officer in January 2025 after serving as Chief People Officer since July 2021. Previously, she was Global Chief People Officer of WPP Group and Executive Vice President, Global People at Walmart.
people.quote:
Jacqueline Canney 
 Chief People and AI Enablement Officer

people.name: Hossein Nowbar
people.title: President, Chief Legal Officer and Secretary
people.bio: Nowbar has served in his current role since December 2025. Previously, he held legal leadership roles at Microsoft, including Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Vice President from 2023 to 2025.
people.quote:
Hossein Nowbar 
 President, Chief Legal Officer and Secretary

people.name: William R. McDermott
people.title: Chair of the Board
people.bio: Serves as ServiceNow's Chairman and CEO, with primary responsibility for operational leadership and strategic direction.

people.name: Susan L. Bostrom
people.title: Lead Independent Director
people.bio: Has served as Lead Independent Director since May 2024 and joined the Board in 2014. Previously chaired the Governance Committee and currently chairs the Leadership Development and Compensation Committee.
people.quote: Ms. Bostrom currently serves as our Lead Independent Director, a role she has held since May 2024.

people.title: Director
